annotations.title: Run a tool that changes data

description: Run a tool that creates, changes, deletes, sends or deploys from any allowed pack by its full name (for example hub_update_product) without it being listed. Only tools find_tools marks as writes are accepted; read-only tools run through call_tool. Arguments follow that tool's own input schema, which find_tools returns.

name.description: The tool's gateway name, e.g. hub_update_product or flow_deploy_flow.
